page_title: PAU 0-1 BAY | St. Pauli v Bayern Munich 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) was probably a bit loose with his words to Timo Gerach, who decides to show him a yellow.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' The substitution is prepared. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jamal Musiala.
90' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
89' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets inside the box and tries to beat Nikola Vasilj with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
89' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Carlo Boukhalfa and he is replaced by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
88' Eric Smith comes off the pitch to be replaced by Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli).
88' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes it short.
87' Bayern Munich fail to score from a corner as Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) leaps to collect the ball. Bayern Munich win a corner.
86' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) for Leroy Sane.
82' Here is a change. Leon Goretzka is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich).
81' The substitution has been made. Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli) has replaced Johannes Eggestein.
80' Bayern Munich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

80' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Nikola Vasilj easily deals with the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
76' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) strikes the ball towards the top left corner of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a superb save.
75' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Nikola Vasilj.
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Oladapo Afolayan will be replaced by Robert Wagner (St. Pauli).
73' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.
72' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Raphael Guerreiro will be replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kingsley Coman leaves the pitch and Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) comes on.
67' Referee Timo Gerach halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Alexander Blessin, then shows him a yellow.
66' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) is booked for saying more than Timo Gerach was willing to tolerate.
66' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.

65' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. St. Pauli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' A yellow card for a tackle by Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli). Timo Gerach doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
63' The free kick from close range, taken by Bayern Munich, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Referee Timo Gerach sees the trip by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bayern Munich.
61' The ball possession at the moment is 24:76.
57' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayern Munich.

53' What a chance! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.
49' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
47' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Bayern Munich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

41' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
40' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
35' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
32' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
29' St. Pauli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. St. Pauli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.

22' 0 - 1 What a hit that is! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) displays his shooting ability as he slams the ball goalwards from distance. His brilliant effort goes in off the crossbar, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
20' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
19' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
17' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is flagged for offside.
15' Nikola Vasilj blocks Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich)'s effort from the edge of the box.
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayern Munich, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick.
12' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' A pass from Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) is intercepted by Manuel Neuer and the move breaks down.
6' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
3' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
St. Pauli will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Timo Gerach.
